thread_messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Chen <samantha@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@acmeinc.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (ACME)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to meet earlier today. As promised, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan ("ACME_MAP_v1" attached) capturing milestones, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close. Key items we discussed:

- Success criteria: <1s median latency for 99% of traffic, SSO + SCIM for SSO test users, SOC2 evidence uploaded, and integration validation on staging.
- Proposed target close: 2026-03-18 (we discussed a 3–4 week timeline).
- Dependencies: SOC2 attestation, legal review (standard SOW redlines), and procurement PO.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached MAP and add/flag any missing milestones or dependencies by EOD Tue (Feb 24).
2) I will incorporate inputs and share v2 with responsibilities and dates.
3) Procurement contact: procurement@acmeinc.com — looping them in now for visibility.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (ACME)

Thanks Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. Quick notes from our side after looping in Legal and Procurement:
- Procurement: we typically need a 10–14 day review for PO issuance once SOW is final.
- Legal: will propose minor redlines to the SOW (mostly IP/indemnity language), expect feedback by Fri (Feb 27).
- Security: we confirmed our security team needs the SOC2 attestation (if you can share that) and an architecture diagram for the integration.

I'll review the MAP and flag any gaps. Can we aim for a final SOW by early March?

Samantha
Head of Platform Ops | Acme, Inc.

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (v2) — milestones & owners

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per your feedback I've incorporated Legal and Procurement timelines and added the security deliverables. Attached is ACME_MAP_v2 (summary below) — please confirm or suggest edits:

MAP highlights (v2):
- Milestone 1: Contract sign & PO issued — Owner: Acme Procurement — Target: 2026-03-05
- Milestone 2: SOC2 attestation provided & architecture diagram — Owner: Redwood Security / Marissa — Target: 2026-02-26 (SOC2 already available; attaching)
- Milestone 3: SSO + SCIM staging validation — Owner: Acme Platform / Redwood Devrel (Vivek) — Target: 2026-03-10
- Milestone 4: Integration validation (staging load test) — Owner: Acme QA / Redwood SRE — Target: 2026-03-14
- Milestone 5: Go-live & billing start — Owner: Acme Product / Redwood Support — Target: 2026-03-18

Dependencies called out: legal redlines resolved, PO issued, SOC2 attestation (attached), and staging access granted.

Attached: ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOC2_Attestation.pdf

If these dates look good I will publish v3 (final signoff MAP + SOW) and share a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Cheers,
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

We're in good shape from our side. Quick status: 
- Legal: sent back redlines yesterday, nothing blocking (minor clarifications).
- Procurement: confirmed we can issue PO once SOW is updated with final pricing; aiming to have PO by 2026-03-05.
- Security: SOC2 attestation received and architecture diagram looks good; SSO test users added to staging.
- QA: completed a short integration smoke test — no major issues.

We consider the success criteria met and are ready to sign the SOW. Please send the final SOW and DocuSign link and we will execute.

Thanks,
Samantha Chen

Fantastic — thank you for the quick turnaround and for confirming the success criteria. Per your request I've attached the final SOW (SOW_ACME_v1.docx) and started a DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123ACME (placeholder link).

Confirmed plan: 
- Target signature date: 2026-03-05 (procurement PO) / DocuSign signature by 2026-03-06
- Go-live date (production traffic): 2026-03-18
- Billing start: upon signature (first invoice will be dated the day of signature).
- Onboarding: Rishi will own the onboarding schedule; Vivek will run the technical kickoff the week of 2026-03-09.

Please reply-all with a one-line confirmation when you're ready for us to send the final DocuSign reminder and to initiate SOW countersigning. I'll wait for your confirmation before I finalize the envelope and notify Legal/Sales Ops to issue the invoice.

Thanks again — excited to get Acme live.

Best,
